C13 shares the foreign-president telegram format but is a welcome message rather than disaster sympathy.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"On behalf of the American people I send deepest sympathy to Your Excellency and to all those who are suffering in this disaster.","parent_excerpt":"I wish to express to you in the name of the Government and the people of the United States our deep sympathy for the suffering caused to so many of the Italian people in the snow-stricken areas of your country.","explanation":"Both use a nearly parallel formula conveying national sympathy through one head of state to another and specifically identify the affected population's suffering."},{"child_excerpt":"His Excellency Camille Chamoun President of the Republic of Lebanon","parent_excerpt":"His Excellency Giovanni Gronchi President of the Italian Republic","explanation":"Both employ the same concise diplomatic-address structure for a message to a foreign president."}]}
